Al-Dawaa Medical Services Co. (DMSCO) is a major Saudi joint-stock healthcare company founded in 1993 and headquartered in Al-Khobar, Saudi Arabia. It operates a vast network of over 900 retail pharmacies across more than 100 cities in the Kingdom, offering pharmaceuticals, medical equipment, and personal care items. [](https://www.al-dawaa.com.sa/)

- **Founding Year:** 1993 (Operations began in Al-Khobar)

- **Headquarters:** Al-Khobar, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia

- **Core Business:** Pharmaceutical retail, wholesale, medical warehousing, and e-commerce delivery

- **Market Status:** Publicly traded joint-stock company listed on the Saudi Exchange (Tadawul: 4163)

- **Official Website:** [Al-Dawaa Pharmacies](https://www.al-dawaa.com/en/?srsltid=AfmBOoqqAITzi9wCXLGLHyGi9rG910mvUD-25WML0j-Qs4H-bqqXqXew)

### Key Operations & Services

- **Retail & Online Pharmacies:** Operates an extensive network of storefronts alongside digital ordering platforms.

- **Product Categories:** Prescriptions, vitamins, baby care, beauty solutions, and medical devices.

- **Logistics & Warehousing:** Manages large-scale medical warehousing and specialized healthcare supply chain services. [](https://www.al-dawaa.com.sa/)
